updates.detailed_summary_zh: Arbitrum 平台已激活 ArbOS 61 Elara 升级，为专属 Arbitrum 链带来可选的合规过滤、可自定义优先费以及替代数据 API，同时为 Arbitrum One 提供了更高效的基准费用机制。合规筛查由链所有者而非 ArbitrumDAO 控制，而在 Arbitrum One 上，优先费仍处于禁用状态，等待进一步的治理投票。 此次升级在 L2/L3 链上引入了协议级合规工具，同时不将筛查强加于 Arbitrum One，从而保留了 DAO 的控制权和用户中立性。这可能使 Arbitrum 技术栈对需要专属链上交易过滤的机构和受监管实体更具吸引力。 ArbOS 61 Elara 还将 Stylus 合约大小上限提高了四倍，扩大了 Arbitrum 链上的智能合约容量。合规过滤在两层运作——定序器（Sequencer）和状态转换函数（STF）——确保无论交易如何进入系统，受限活动都会被阻止，并且该功能在 Arbitrum One 和 Nova 上默认保持关闭。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Arbitrum platform activated the ArbOS 61 Elara upgrade, bringing optional compliance filtering, customizable priority fees, and an alternative data API to dedicated Arbitrum chains, while delivering a more efficient base fee mechanism on Arbitrum One. Chain owners—not the ArbitrumDAO—control compliance screening on dedicated networks, and priority fees remain disabled on Arbitrum One pending a further governance vote. This upgrade introduces protocol-level compliance tooling for Layer 2/3 chains without imposing screening on Arbitrum One, preserving DAO control and user neutrality. It could make the Arbitrum stack more attractive to institutions and regulated entities that need on-chain transaction filtering for dedicated chains. ArbOS 61 Elara also quadruples Stylus contract size limits, expanding smart-contract capacity on Arbitrum chains. Compliance filtering operates across two layers—the Sequencer and the State Transition Function (STF)—ensuring restricted activity is blocked regardless of how a transaction enters the system, and it remains off by default on Arbitrum One and Nova.
